decisions.reason: Unlike the three carpets already withdrawn, this low-pile carpet survived the 2024 pruning, which suggests some positive demand signal; with low holding costs in a broad portfolio, the option is worth keeping open a while longer, though carpet ranges rotate often.

The multi-model swivel shell chair line is close to the core seating business and serves both contract and residential demand, so it remains a valuable option still resolving its uncertainty at modest cost.
